'''Garu-bears''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bear/Legends|bear]] known for protecting their cubs. Because of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[coomb spore]] diseased that attacked her organs, when [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] first learned that [[Gender/Legends|she]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] with her son [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] she briefly considered medical options of terminating the pregnancy to prevent the disease from attacking her child. When she dismissed the idea almost immediately, it was akin to a garu-bear protecting her cub.<ref name="Balance Point" />
